Subject: Pause sandbox timer - procurement audit blocking PO

Hi Mina,

Quick note — we're mid-way through an internal procurement audit at WellSpan and the PO approvals are stalled with finance. Legal flagged vendor onboarding items and finance put a temporary hold. The sandbox we spun up for the pilot is due to expire next week and the team still needs the environment to keep validating integrations.

Could Redwood pause the trial timer or issue a short voucher so we don't lose progress? Ideally we'd like a 10–14 day pause while the PO gets routed. We're still committed to moving forward, it's just a paperwork delay.

I've attached a screenshot of the vendor ticket from our finance portal showing the audit status in case that helps.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Digital Innovation — WellSpan Health

Samira — thanks for the context and the screenshot. Totally understandable and we want to make sure the pilot momentum isn't lost.

Proposed options:
- Issue a 14-day trial voucher (no billing changes) to keep the sandbox live while the PO routes.
- Or we can 'pause' the trial countdown for up to 10 business days if you prefer not to accept a voucher.

If you want the voucher, I can get approval internally this week and send a DocuSign/acknowledgement for your records. Either way, please confirm preferred option and any internal approver we should loop in.

I'll loop Camila from CS to coordinate the technical handoff and make sure no data is lost during the extension.

Best,
